name: MTH 308 190 MAX (MTH, 190 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".564 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".289 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 2, MTH-Match, Tactical, Hunting: Caliber .308, Grains 190, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number MTH 308 190 MAX, G1 BC .564 (A.B.), G7 BC .289 (A.B.), OAL 1.572", Bullet Projection 1.106"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.106". The same G1 .564 and G7 .289 are printed for MTAC 264 143 MAX.
